result:
I've saved the Q3 answers to `answer.json`. Before running Q3, I ran the same calculation on Q2 and got all 10 of your reference values exactly.

| Item | Q3 result |
|---|---|
| a. Segment with the highest net sales | smb, 316,534,383 KRW |
| b. Customers with paid orders | 248 |
| c. Category with the highest net sales | svc, 312,755,660 KRW |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-07 |
| e. Customer with the largest total refunds | u93@ex.com |
| f. Customers with 2+ paid orders | 240 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 692,548 KRW |
| h. September vs. August growth | -3.3% |

The data had three issues the definitions didn't mention. I had to adjust for each one to reproduce the Q2 values:

1. **Time zone:** Order times are stored in UTC. I converted them to Korean time (+9 hours) before cutting off the quarter and assigning months. Without this, the Q2 month (d) and growth rate (h) came out wrong.
2. **Duplicate customers:** Of 300 customer records, only 250 have distinct emails. I treated each email as one customer, which changes the counts in b and f.
3. **Inconsistent segment labels:** Some values differ only in capitalization or spaces (e.g. `SMB`/`smb`, ` consumer`/`consumer`). I made them all lowercase and removed the spaces.

STATUS: DONE
